normalization.policy: Consistent Persian orthography without destructive rewriting

sources.provenance: Original synthetic Persian passages authored for SimaNNDS
Original synthetic Persian instruction and dialogue examples authored for SimaNNDS

limitations: This is a small starter corpus, not a comprehensive Persian language dataset.
Synthetic passages may contain simplifications and should not be treated as verified factual reference material.
Conversation JSONL is not directly consumed by the current SimaNN text-only trainer.
The current byte-level RNN has very limited model capacity.
next_steps: Expand the raw-text corpus with additional original domains and styles.
Evaluate and document properly licensed public Persian corpora before importing them.
Add stronger deduplication and text-quality checks.
Implement a conversation/SFT data format only after the model architecture supports it.
